payload.title: No Graph request follows a redirect
payload.context: Images review (#25): Guzzle keeps method and body on 307 and 308, so a redirect could have re-sent the token and the file elsewhere.
payload.rationale: Every Facebook request turns redirects off. A 3xx is a failure: retryable where the call is safe to repeat, an unknown outcome for a post.
payload.consequences: Applies to connect, publish, upload and delete.
